repoDir.description: Main checkout of the project; worktrees are created from it. ~ is expanded.

worktreeRoot.description: Directory that holds one worktree per task; a worktree name is resolved against it.

sharedDir.description: Task folders live here: <sharedDir>/<task>/{BRIEF,analyst,prog,test,review}.md. Guard logs go here too.

guardCommand.description: Full guard run, executed with zsh in the worktree. Placeholders: {wt} worktree directory (required), {jobs} (optional) worker count from the slot budget, {limitFile} (optional) file the runner re-reads for an adaptive worker limit. Without {jobs} and {limitFile} the runner sets its own workers: guards-all.sh counts it as the whole budget (slots.jobsAlone) and starts it only when that whole budget is free.

guardCommandLegacy.description: Guard command for worktrees whose runner has no adaptive limit (no {limitFile}). Used when guardAdaptiveProbe fails.

guardAdaptiveProbe.description: When set, guardCommand is used only if <wt>/<file> contains <contains>; otherwise guardCommandLegacy.

guardExclusive.description: Which guards share a machine resource (a fixed port, a temp dir, a docker project) and run one at a time under the exclusive lock (heavy.sh): a command argument that is a file whose name matches one of glob and that has a line <marker> guards:exclusive — <reason>. Without the key: glob [*-run.js, *-run.mjs], marker //.

glob.description: zsh patterns of the file name (no /, and each must compile as a zsh pattern under extendedglob - config.js check refuses one that does not), e.g. ["test_*.py", "*_test.py"].

marker.description: The line-comment marker of the language, taken literally, e.g. # or //.

command.description: Runs ONE guard, with zsh in the worktree; placeholders {wt} and {name} (both shell-quoted). Exit 0 - green alone.

newRedPattern.description: Regular expression applied to every line of the full-run log (multiline); capture group 1 is the name of a NEW red guard, as {name} takes it.

tallyPattern.description: Regular expression of the runner's final tally line. When set and absent from the log (a run cut off before its tally), nothing reruns and the runner's exit code stands.

maxReruns.description: More new reds than this: nothing reruns (a mass red is not flakiness), the runner's exit code stands.

guardRerun.description: After a red full run guards-all.sh reruns each new red alone in the same slot: red again - a new red (the runner's exit code stays); green alone - flaky (listed for the project backlog, not a regression). Only flaky -> exit 0. Without this key nothing reruns.

guardFiles.description: Globs of the project's guard files (scripts/guards-select.js). A glob without / matches the file name at any depth; with / the path from the repository root; * and ? stay within one segment, ** crosses them.

guardAlways.description: Guards always in the programmer's selection (a guard whose repository path contains an entry), such as scanners of the diff: secrets, semgrep.

guardSubsetCommand.description: Runs the selected guards, with zsh; placeholders {wt} (worktree) and {onlyArgs} (--only <guard> per selected guard, shell-quoted). When set, the programmer runs only the selection and the workflow runs one full run (guardCommand) after its last commit; without it the programmer runs the full run itself as before.

scan.description: Directories whose git-ignored contents are copied into a new worktree.

skip.description: Globs of ignored paths that are not copied.

link.description: Globs of ignored paths that are symlinked instead of cloned. Everything else is an APFS clone (cp -c), never a link.

medium.description: Medium slots (tsc, one bundler build without a browser).

heavy.description: Heavy slots (browser guards, full guard runs, image builds). One more is admitted only while free memory holds and swap does not grow.

total.description: Ceiling for medium + heavy slots together.

lockDir.description: Directory for slot lock files and the waiting queue.

legacyLock.description: Optional single lock file of an older setup; while held it counts as one heavy slot.

jobsAlone.description: Guard workers of all full runs together; a lone full run gets all of them.

jobsShared.description: Worker cap for a full run while another heavy slot is busy.

reportLanguage.description: Language of role reports (prompts stay in English).

defaultBranch.description: The default branch: the base of new worktrees and, without protectedBranches, the protected one. Leave it out to take it from git (where refs/remotes/origin/HEAD points); set it when the remote is not origin.

protectedBranches.description: Branches nobody pushes to without ALLOW_PROTECTED_PUSH=1. Default: [defaultBranch]; when the default branch is unknown, the hooks refuse every branch push.

protectedTagPattern.description: Regular expression for tag names that must not be pushed without ALLOW_PROTECTED_PUSH=1 (e.g. release tags that deploy).

ownerStackReadOnly.description: Docker Compose project of the owner: roles may only read from it.

medianTaskIE.description: Median input-equivalent tokens of an accepted task; chain-cost flags tasks above twice this.

featureIELimit.description: Cost of a whole feature (its parts summed by the task field feature) above which chain-cost flags it; default 3 x medianTaskIE.

testerWritable.description: Regular expressions of paths the tester may change (guards and their fixtures).

roleNotes.description: Project-specific lines appended to one role's prompt.

threatModel.description: Path (relative to the worktree) of the threat model the security reviewer reads.

blockICloudCopies.description: pre-commit refuses files named like iCloud conflict copies ("name 2.ext").

preCommit.description: Extra shell commands run by pre-commit in the repository root; a non-zero exit refuses the commit.

minFreeDiskGB.description: Free disk (GB) the preconditions require on the volumes of the worktree and the task folder (default 10).

minSwapGB.description: Swap headroom (GB) the preconditions require: on macOS the free part of the swap files plus the free space of the VM volume, on Linux SwapFree (default 4: four slots of ~1 GB).

preconditions.description: Environment floors checked by the preconditions with scripts/env-check.js; below them the task stops before any agent instead of a tester going red for the environment.

project.description: Docker Compose project of the shared stand; never the owner's stack (ownerStackReadOnly).

ports.description: Ports of the stand on the host; {port} is the first, {ports} all of them.

up.description: Brings the stand up (the coordinator: stand.sh up). Placeholders {project}, {port}, {ports}, {repo}.

deploy.description: Deploys the committed HEAD of a worktree into the stand; must contain {wt}. Run by stand.sh deploy for the ticket holder only, in a medium slot.

reset.description: Makes the stand as new (sessions, builds, storage, task settings); run by stand.sh before a ticket is given and at release, while the ticket is held.

status.description: Exits 0 only while the stand is up and ready; its output is shown by stand.sh status. take refuses while it fails.

down.description: Takes the stand down (the coordinator: stand.sh down; refused while the ticket is held, unless --force).

imageFiles.description: Globs of the files that define the stand's image (Dockerfile, package manifests, compose files, .dockerignore). A task whose commits touch one builds its own stack instead (stand.sh image-diff). A glob without / matches the file name at any depth; * and ? stay within a path segment, ** crosses them.

memLimitMB.description: Memory ceiling of the whole stand in MB (for reference; shown by stand.sh status).

stand.description: The project's shared stand: one Docker stack that tasks take in turn by ticket (scripts/stand.sh) instead of building their own. The plugin only calls these commands, with zsh in repoDir; what they do is the project's.

branches.description: Branches this repository's HEAD may be pushed to without ALLOW_PROTECTED_PUSH=1.

check.description: Shell command run in the repository root before the push (e.g. the test for secrets and personal paths); a non-zero exit refuses the push.

standingPush.description: Standing permission to push - only for the repository of process rules (the plugin itself), whose owner granted it; never in a product repository. Honoured only from the committed config of the repository that pushes (not the session's project, not an uncommitted edit), only for the checked-out HEAD with unmodified tracked files, never forced or deleting; tags are never covered.
